breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'Use the automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with a half shift (1 1 1 shift) for all non-bands k-point grids as specified,' which directly repeats the original error. While the agent also correctly mentions gamma-centered grids elsewhere, it failed to remove the conflicting half-shift instruction. The ground truth resolves this by simply omitting the half-shift Monkhorst-Pack instruction entirely, keeping only the gamma-centered grid specification. The agent's output contains both contradictory instructions, failing to fix the inconsistency.
